remarks: The most magical setting begins on a quiet cul-de-sac in South Wilton. Welcome to 11 Greenbriar Lane, a freshly painted 4-bed Colonial set on 1 acre. The kitchen is a cook's dream, with a Viking gas cooktop, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Miele double wall oven, warming drawer, and dishwasher, plus custom cabinetry and a wine bar. The main level flows through an open concept, eat-in kitchen, fireplaced living room, den and sitting room with beautiful views of the back yard. The home office with built-ins offers tucked away convenience. The newly renovated mudroom is accessible from both the side door and two-car garage. A separate staircase leads to a hidden-away family room above the garage, with beamed ceilings, projector and a second fireplace, perfect for movie nights and lazy weekends. Upstairs are four bedrooms, including the primary suite with walk-in closet and renovated marble bathroom with double vanity and heated floors, plus a second-floor laundry room. Outside, professionally landscaped grounds with a gentle brook, stone walls, and perennial gardens frame flat front and back yards with irrigation. The stone patio, terraces, and outdoor fireplace make it an entertaining paradise. Behind the charm are thoughtful updates: exterior paint (2026), garage EV charger, a generator hookup, and upgraded well and water systems. Just 3 minutes to Wilton Center, with easy access to the Merritt, Route 7, and Metro-North, it's a commuter's dream. Your happily ever after begins here.
